title: Grateful Dead Live at Danish Center on 1966-03-12

ai_review.summary: Raw, high‑energy 1966 blues set featuring a smoking Viola Lee Blues and Pigpen‑fronted gems, captured on solid soundboard tape though the mix is uneven in places.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an electrifying glimpse of early Dead, with Pigpen’s powerful vocals leading a tight three‑song segment that includes a monster Viola Lee Blues, a soulful You See A Broken Heart and an exuberant Midnight Hour. The soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, but the drums sit low and pitch‑speed anomalies reveal that some tracks were mis‑identified from other dates.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and raw excitement, noting standout Pigpen songs; recording is described as good with minor mix issues, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard mix praised for its raw energy; drums are faint and some tracks run slightly fast/slow due to mis‑labeling, causing minor pitch issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short three‑song segment that feels tight and raw; reviewers note confusion over track provenance but agree the music flows with high excitement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Heavy‑handed leads, memorable Garcia solo imitating a Martha & the Vandellas horn line, and strong call‑and‑response with Pigpen.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are almost inaudible in parts, making the rhythm section feel thin.
